name: nook-learning
description: L5 Gauss Learning (Pech). Per-developer spend-pattern accumulation across sessions. Builds weighted moving averages of cost-per-(skill, session_type, model) so anomaly detection has meaningful μ after the first 30 calls. Emu-A4 atomic serialization. Exports to shared/learnings.json for cross-plugin intelligence.
